# Design Partner Addendum (Template)

> Founding-customer addendum to the Operator Service Agreement, for the bounded design-partner cohort. Internal drafting template; not a final form.

---

## When to use this template

This addendum is used when an engagement is a **design-partner** (founding-customer) engagement: one of a small, bounded cohort of early customers who adopt the Operator before a general reference base exists, in exchange for founding terms and a structured feedback relationship. It attaches to the Service Agreement as Exhibit D and modifies it as stated below.

The design-partner cohort is deliberately bounded and reversible. The purpose is to contain reference-zero risk for both Parties: Customer takes a bounded, exitable bet on a vendor without an established reference base, and SMD earns the operating experience and the references that retire that risk for the cohort that follows. Founding fee treatment is the consideration SMD provides for Customer's structured feedback and reference cooperation.

## Bracketed field reference

| Field                          | Meaning                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[CUSTOMER LEGAL NAME]`        | The customer's full legal entity name.                                                             |
| `[EFFECTIVE DATE]`             | The date this Addendum becomes effective (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD).                                   |
| `[DESIGN PARTNER FEE]`         | The founding monthly fee for the design-partner engagement, stated in U.S. dollars.                |
| `[DESIGN PARTNER TERM MONTHS]` | The length of the design-partner period, in months.                                                |
| `[FEE LOCK MONTHS]`            | The period after the design-partner term during which the founding fee is held, in months.         |
| `[EXIT NOTICE DAYS]`           | The advance notice period for Customer's standing convenience exit during the design-partner term. |
| `[FEEDBACK CADENCE]`           | The agreed cadence for structured feedback sessions (for example, "every two weeks").              |
| `[CUSTOMER SIGNATORY NAME]`    | The name of the individual signing for the customer.                                               |
| `[CUSTOMER SIGNATORY TITLE]`   | The title of the individual signing for the customer.                                              |
| `[ADDITIONAL TERMS]`           | Any negotiated additions specific to this engagement.                                              |

# Design Partner Addendum

**This Design Partner Addendum (this "Addendum") is entered into as of [EFFECTIVE DATE] (the "Effective Date") between SMDurgan, LLC (d/b/a SMD Services) ("SMD") and [CUSTOMER LEGAL NAME] ("Customer"). This Addendum forms Exhibit D to, and modifies, the Operator Service Agreement between the Parties dated [EFFECTIVE DATE] (the "Service Agreement"). Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings given in the Service Agreement and its Exhibits. To the extent of a conflict between this Addendum and the body of the Service Agreement on a matter this Addendum addresses, this Addendum controls; on every other matter, the Service Agreement controls.**

## 1. Design Partner Status

1.1 Customer is a design partner: one of a bounded cohort of founding customers adopting the Operator before a general reference base exists. The Parties acknowledge that the Service is in an early phase, that Customer's engagement is in part a collaboration to mature it, and that both Parties expect iteration during the design-partner term.

1.2 This Addendum does not reduce any confidentiality, security, data-protection, service-level, indemnification, insurance, or liability protection in the Service Agreement, the DPA, or any applicable confidentiality addendum. Those protections apply in full. Founding fee treatment under Section 2 is the consideration for Customer's participation and reference cooperation under Sections 3 and 4; it is not a discount in exchange for reduced protection.

## 2. Founding Fee Treatment

2.1 **Founding fee.** Notwithstanding Service Agreement Section 3.1, the monthly Fee during the design-partner term is [DESIGN PARTNER FEE].

2.2 **Fee hold.** SMD will not increase the founding fee during the design-partner term or for [FEE LOCK MONTHS] months thereafter. Any fee change after that period follows Service Agreement Section 3.5.

2.3 **No reduction in service for founding fee.** The founding fee covers the same Service, infrastructure, and operational budget described in the Service Agreement and Exhibit A, except as the Parties expressly state in Section 6 (Additional Terms).

## 3. Customer Participation

3.1 **Structured feedback.** Customer will participate in structured feedback sessions on the [FEEDBACK CADENCE] cadence, through Customer's named champion, for the design-partner term. The sessions cover the Operator's performance, accuracy, fit to Customer's workflows, and any defects or gaps Customer observes.

3.2 **Reasonable access for iteration.** Customer will provide SMD with the reasonable access and timely responses needed to act on feedback, consistent with the Customer responsibilities already stated in the Service Agreement. Participation does not obligate Customer to accept any configuration change; the Entitlement Configuration remains Customer's to author.

3.3 **No obligation to disclose Customer confidences.** Nothing in this Section requires Customer to disclose Protected Information, client confidences, or other Confidential Information beyond what the Service already processes under the Service Agreement and its Addenda.

## 4. Reference and Case-Study Cooperation

4.1 **Identification as a design partner.** Customer grants SMD the right to identify Customer as a design partner of the Operator, subject to Section 4.3.

4.2 **Case study.** The Parties may collaborate on a case study describing the engagement. SMD will prepare any case study and reference material and submit it to Customer for review.

4.3 **Customer approval controls every public use.** No public use of Customer's name, logo, quotes, metrics, or any description of Customer's business or results occurs without Customer's prior written approval of that specific use. Customer may withhold approval in its discretion, may require changes, and may revoke approval for future use on written notice. Any figure, quote, or claim attributed to Customer must be one Customer has approved in writing; SMD will not publish an invented or unapproved figure, quote, or outcome. This Section survives termination as to material already approved, subject to Customer's right to revoke future use.

4.4 **No compelled reference.** Customer is not obligated to serve as a sales reference, take reference calls, or provide a testimonial. Reference activity beyond Section 4.1 is at Customer's election.

## 5. Standing Exit and Reversibility

5.1 **Standing convenience exit.** In addition to the Evaluation Period in Service Agreement Section 9.2(a), Customer may terminate the Service Agreement for convenience at any time during the design-partner term by giving SMD at least [EXIT NOTICE DAYS] days' written notice. On such termination, SMD refunds the unearned portion of any prepaid Fee and no early-termination charge applies. This Section overrides Service Agreement Section 9.2(c) for the design-partner term.

5.2 **Portability on exit.** On any exit, Customer receives the portable export of its Memory Artifact per DPA Section 11 and the offboarding and decommissioning steps in Service Agreement Section 9.4 and DPA Section 10. The reversibility of the engagement is a term of it: Customer leaves with its configuration and memory, and its substrate is decommissioned with written confirmation.

5.3 **Roadmap input, not a guarantee.** SMD will give design partners' input meaningful weight in prioritizing the Operator's development. This is a commitment to listen, not a commitment to build any specific feature on any timeline.

## 6. Conversion to Standard Terms

6.1 At the end of the design-partner term, the engagement continues under the Service Agreement on its standard terms, with the founding fee held per Section 2.2. The design-partner participation obligations in Section 3 end with the design-partner term unless the Parties agree in writing to extend them.
